title: 大地圖
claim: Big-map scene over the decoded BigMap.SHP with bigmap.dat points, TRACK.TXT polylines and m_pnt/m_trk sprites; travel, hit areas, marker kinds and the party marker are remake readings; the music follows the original (06 on the map, 05 in an opened town, original_music.md §3.2).

travel.note: pixels_per_second: the original sets the walker's 16.16 speed to 0x20000 (2 px per logic tick, 0x4277ed) and the tick is 16 ms (docs/evidence_packets/runtime_observations/original_tick_rate/README.md), so 125 px/s is the design speed; point_hit_half_extent: the original point initialiser writes a [-16,-16,16,16] hit box (0x427f0d, static-derived); track reveal: the original grows a square clip round the track's anchor (its from point) 1 px per logic tick for max(anchor-to-edge) ticks (0x4280d0) — WorldMapRuntime runs it on OriginalTick; endpoints appear at once when it ends (point phase-1 settles to 2 immediately, 0x427f0d)

unresolved_semantics: the travel animation is unproven beyond the 16.16 speed value 2 per 16 ms tick (0x4277ed → 125 px/s); the point hit box ±16 is static-derived
M_PNT001..003 are the three frames of one point shape selected by type (POINT.H Battle 0 / General 1 / Town 2, static-derived 0x427f0d); the remake loads them as three textures
the party marker reuses Leonard's battle walk frames (actor 001) at half scale; the original big-map party sprite is not located

the big-map music is located (static-derived, docs/evidence_packets/static_reverse/original_music.md §3.2): level 49 plays its table track 06 at init (0x427532, resources.map_music), a town that loads plays 05 (0x4564e1, resources.town_music) and back on the map 06 starts again from the beginning (0x427d31); a town that did not open (result 2) leaves the track alone, which the remake reads as its picture-card towns

point / track field0 is the show phase (0 not shown / 1 revealing / 2 stable, static-derived) and a new game hides 17 points and 18 tracks by code; a track enters its revealing phase through 0x426e40(walker, point) (static-derived), called from walker 0x427420 sub-state 0 (the current point on map entry) and sub-state 1 (show-track requests) and from 0x427d36 (call site 0x427d48: a destination whose dispatch does not hold, and the way back from a town)

arrival follows the original handler's branches (static-derived, 0x427ab3: event 0 nothing for every type, Town included (0x427aca); General unvisited → event, visited → encounter when 0x458c80(100)+1 ≤ ratio, then event + 0..2; Battle → event, + 0..2 once visited; Town only as the chosen destination); Visit is written right after the level request (0x427b54) or on town entry (0x427b88) and never when the dispatch does not hold (0x427d36 reveals the point's routes instead)

m_trk sprites carry a baked red→white gradient; the original reveals a track by expanding a clip rectangle (mode 1, 0x4280d0) and its callbacks hold no colour interpolation — the remake runs the same square clip per tick

the town screen follows the original composition (runtime-measured, docs/evidence_packets/runtime_observations/original_world_town/README.md: undimmed big map, TownBG at (158,148), WINDOW70 menu board at (60,60) with white entry rows, NPC lines on a top board and party lines on the bottom board — the top/bottom split generalised from 7 lines is provisional); the town name, gold/party strip and 離開城鎮 are remake extras placed outside it, and the shop panel is a remake composition (no original shop capture); message pacing (if_wait is 0 on every TOWNDEF message; the remake waits for a confirm each time) and teDelay units are unproven

shop transactions are remake policy: goods cost their ITEM.TXT price and go to one chosen member's first empty slot, selling returns half the listed price rounded down, important items cannot be sold; the original buy/sell handler is not located
each town's initial root menu comes from town_initial_trees.json, whose roots/children match the original initialiser's executed result (static-derived, 0x454a20)

new_game.source: docs/evidence_packets/static_reverse/original_world_town.md — new game (0x42c86e..0x42ca2a) sets point 1 to mode 2 after loading bigmap.dat and ORs bmpmHidden on these points and tracks

status_bar.note: obj12 defProcBigMapStatusBar draws STATUS_BAR.SHP at camera + (0, 412) with RESOURCE 360 「完成度：」 plus the completion percent (shown non-hidden points over named points − 1, 0x427200) and the cumulative play time as h:mm:ss (0x42d090); the timer's tick source was not executed. The drawing is runtime-measured on the original big-map frame (docs/evidence_packets/runtime_observations/original_world_town/01-bigmap-status-bar.png): the shape is subtracted from the map beneath it (frame 04 fits dst - 1.04 x src, RMS 3.3) and the texts are colour-code @5 yellow / @1 white rows with their shadows at x 6 / 114 / right edge 634 on the y 427-444 glyph row
